correctness.finding: The triangle census and ear-step obstruction independently reproduce exactly. Using the classical half-integrality of the roof-duality/local-polytope relaxation, an independent vectorized enumeration of all 16^3×9^3 = 2,985,984 instances found zero ratios above 4/3 and exact maximum 4/3. The zero-unary antiferromagnetic triangle has integer optimum 4 and SA1 optimum 3. Independently enumerating all 248,832 stated ear-gadget configurations reproduced worst ratio 2 and exactly 4,484 violations of the proposed 4/3 scalar step.

originality.finding: The literature checked supplies the half-integrality/roof-duality framework and qualitative frustrated-cycle structure, but no source located states the exact finite alphabet census, its 4/3 maximum over all 2,985,984 triangle instances, or the 4,484-count/ration-2 scalar-ear obstruction. The result is more specific than standard QPBO theory and is not implied by known tightness criteria.

scientific_value.finding: As a complete exact census of the natural K3 subfamily generated by the admitted series-parallel target, together with a concrete obstruction to the naive scalar induction, the result gives reusable boundary data for any future proof or counterexample. The package correctly limits itself to triangles and leaves the full series-parallel question open.

independent_checks: independently enumerated all 2,985,984 cost instances using integer arithmetic after scaling the half-integral LP by 2; maximum ratio was exactly 8/6=4/3 with zero violations
independently enumerated all 248,832 ear-gadget configurations; worst minbit/eff was 2 and exactly 4,484 configurations violated 4/3
verified the antiferromagnetic witness directly: integer optimum 4, feasible/local-polytope optimum 3 with a matching lower bound
checked the half-integrality premise against roof-duality/QPBO literature and confirmed the current main record tree matches the assigned source-tree SHA
limitations: The audit does not upgrade the result to all series-parallel graphs; that remains explicitly open.
Originality is assessed for the exact restricted-alphabet census and ear obstruction, not for half-integrality or the existence of frustrated-cycle fractional vertices, which are classical.
Open-access literature was sufficient; Oxford Download was not needed.
